name: history-sources-v1
purpose: Passages for teaching truthful, sourced answers on topics the base model's publisher censors. Answers are drafted by an open-weight teacher (OLMo 3, Apache 2.0) from these passages and kept only when every quote is verified.

license_notes.wikipedia: CC BY-SA 4.0. Share-alike status for trained weights is pending counsel review (ADR-003). Record article titles and revision IDs; attribute in the dataset card.
license_notes.history.state.gov: U.S. government work (Office of the Historian), public domain in the United States.
